T: Order the pizza. Set up the bosses.
D: Two overworked assistants plot to set up their demanding bosses so they can finally get some free time.
P: Serve the mains when Harper and Charlie share a late-night pizza in the empty office.
S: Harper and Charlie sharing pizza in the empty office
Pizza dough stretched thin, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 250C for 10 minutes, eaten straight from the box.
the baseball game where they stage the kiss cam
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and fried onions, wrapped in paper.
the assistants never getting a lunch break
Almonds roasted at 180C for 10 minutes, mixed with pretzels and dried apricots, tipped into bowls to graze on at the desk.
M: the fancy dinner the assistants set up for their bosses
Sirloin steaks seared and rested, sliced with a cream and peppercorn sauce, crispy roast potatoes and buttered asparagus.
long nights working in New York
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, broccoli and capsicum in a sticky soy and honey sauce, served in takeaway boxes.
W: the office parties the assistants have to organise
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and piped with vanilla buttercream and sprinkles.
K: Strong espresso with steamed milk, served in takeaway cups.

s.note: Harper and Charlie sharing pizza in the empty office
s.how: Stretch pizza dough thin on a tray. Spread with pizza sauce, scatter with grated mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until bubbling. Cut and put back in a box, then eat on the office floor at midnight.

s.note: the baseball game where they stage the kiss cam
s.how: Fry 2 sliced onions slowly until soft and golden. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns with the onions and yellow mustard and wrap in paper. Hand them to the bosses as the kiss cam swings around.

m.note: the fancy dinner the assistants set up for their bosses
m.how: Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Steam asparagus and toss with butter. Serve on white plates.

w.note: the office parties the assistants have to organise
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe vanilla buttercream on top and finish with sprinkles. Leave a tray in the break room.

d.how: Pull a strong double shot of espresso into each takeaway cup. Steam milk until silky and pour in. Snap on a lid and run it upstairs before the boss notices you have been busy setting up a love life.
